seo.title: SmartFlow — flashcards and spaced repetition
seo.description: SmartFlow case study: flashcard creation, spaced repetition, scheduled reviews and a progress dashboard built with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.

hero.description: SmartFlow turns knowledge into question-and-answer cards and schedules reviews based on previous answers, without requiring a manually maintained study plan.

overview.problem: Creating flashcards is only the beginning. Learners also need to know what to review, when to revisit it, and how they are progressing without juggling multiple tools.
overview.solution: One app combines card creation, organization and recall sessions. A scheduling engine computes due dates, while a dashboard brings together pending cards and progress indicators.
overview.audience: Students and other people learning information they need to remember
overview.scope: Cards, categories, reviews, reporting, APIs and persistence

visual.title: Question, category, answer
visual.description: Enter a question, optionally select a category, then add its answer in a guided flow. The card is saved and can immediately be opened for its first review.

visual.title: Cards and categories
visual.description: Search cards by question or answer and filter the collection by category. Color-coded categories keep content organized without requiring every card to belong to one.

visual.title: A queue prepared for today
visual.description: Open a queue of due cards generated from their previous review dates and mastery levels. The scheduling engine checks due dates and prepares the cards to review.

visual.title: Each answer changes the plan
visual.description: Reveal the answer, mark it as remembered or missed, and move to the next card. Success advances the card to a higher level; failure returns it to the first level.

architecture.description: The React interface calls Next.js API routes, where review logic runs and data is read or updated through Prisma and PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Web interface
nodes.role: Card creation, review sessions and progress

nodes.label: API routes
nodes.role: Auth, due-date logic and domain actions

nodes.label: Database
nodes.role: Cards, categories, accounts and review history

challenges.title: Keep review due dates consistent
challenges.constraint: Level rules spread across UI screens can produce inconsistent dates, especially around day boundaries.
challenges.solution: A single domain module calculates due dates, overdue days and progression using Europe/Paris as the reference time zone.

challenges.title: Preserve reliable review history
challenges.constraint: A card’s latest review date cannot reconstruct historical activity or consistency across sessions.
challenges.solution: Each assessment updates the card and writes a review-log entry within the same Prisma transaction.

challenges.title: Tailor reporting to user progress
challenges.constraint: An empty account, a new learner and an active learner each need different progress information.
challenges.solution: A data calculator isolated from database access produces dashboard tiles and states tailored to each account’s situation.

outcomes.title: An end-to-end review experience
outcomes.description: Card creation, organization, daily queues, answer reveals and level-based progression work together in one application.

outcomes.title: A contextual progress dashboard
outcomes.description: The dashboard shows cards due, mastery levels, categories and indicators built from the review log.

outcomes.title: Version-controlled checks
outcomes.description: The repository includes Vitest unit tests and Playwright scenarios covering workflows, network states and responsive interfaces.
